title: Mortuary Data Wake
body: A funeral for corrupted data invites you to inherit what the dead routines left behind.

choices.label: Inherit the router
choices.description: Add Junk to your deck. Add Lag to your deck. Gain Mortuary Router.

choices.label: Read the wake list
choices.description: Gain 35 credits.

choices.label: Pay respects
choices.description: Heal 6 HP. Remove 1 Junk from your deck if present.

title: Spine Core Vespers
body: A civic prayer service runs on a timer older than the city and twice as strict.

choices.label: Accept the spine script
choices.description: Take 8 damage. Increase Protocol Drift by 8%. Gain Spine Script.

choices.label: Copy one verse
choices.description: Next combat: draw 1 extra card on turn 1.

choices.label: Interrupt the sermon
choices.description: Gain 30 credits. Next combat: start with 1 Suppressed.

title: Triune Gate
body: A three-lobed gate opens only when offense, defense, and power arrive in the same breath.

choices.label: Take the triune module
choices.description: Take 15 damage. Increase Protocol Drift by 8%. Gain Triune Module.

choices.label: Practice the sequence
choices.description: Next combat: draw 1 extra card on turn 1.

choices.label: Break one lobe loose
choices.description: Spend 20 credits. Add Control Tower to your deck.

title: Flesh Dividend Clinic
body: A biotech clinic promises that pain can become profit if you sign before bleeding.

choices.label: Sign the flesh dividend
choices.description: Take 12 damage. Increase Protocol Drift by 6%. Gain Flesh Dividend.

choices.label: Take the recovery payout
choices.description: Heal 18 HP. Gain Debt Spike.

choices.label: Audit the clinic
choices.description: Gain 40 credits.

title: Grave Matrix Obelisk
body: A black obelisk projects every enemy as already half buried.

choices.label: Install the grave matrix
choices.description: Spend 40 credits. Gain Grave Matrix.

choices.label: Light the grave lantern
choices.description: Take 8 damage. Gain Grave Lantern.

choices.label: Offer the first tally
choices.description: Take 8 damage. Gain Reaper Census.

title: Controlled Bleed Theater
body: A surgical theater teaches wounds to reopen on command.

choices.label: Install the bleed valve
choices.description: Take 8 damage. Gain Controlled Bleed Valve.

choices.label: Take the arterial tank
choices.description: Increase Protocol Drift by 4%. Gain Arterial Reservoir. Next combat: start with 2 Bleed.

choices.label: Sell the technique
choices.description: Gain 50 credits. Remove 1 Strike from your deck if present.

title: Auction Seed Vault
body: A vault of auction seeds grows better choices in exchange for worse instincts.

choices.label: Buy the auction seeder
choices.description: Spend 50 credits. Gain Auction Seeder.

choices.label: Steal a seedbox
choices.description: Take 10 damage. Increase Protocol Drift by 6%. Gain Auction Seeder.

choices.label: Take router cuttings
choices.description: Gain Signal Router. Gain Debt Mark.

title: Protocol Drift Cradle
body: A cradle of corrupted cassettes rocks itself with every hostile signal in the room.

choices.label: Take the drift cassette
choices.description: Take 10 damage. Increase Protocol Drift by 10%. Gain Protocol Drift.

choices.label: Tune the cassette you already carry
choices.description: Reduce Protocol Drift by 5%. Add Glitch to your deck.

choices.label: Seal the cradle
choices.description: Gain 15 credits. Reduce Protocol Drift by 7%.

title: Recycler Crown Yard
body: A crown of shredder teeth rises from the yard, hungry for junk and useful accidents.

choices.label: Wear the recycler crown
choices.description: Increase Protocol Drift by 5%. Add Junk to your deck. Add Lag to your deck. Add Glitch to your deck. Gain Recycler Crown.

choices.label: Sell the teeth
choices.description: Gain 55 credits.

choices.label: Feed the old router
choices.description: Add Control Tower to your deck. Remove 1 Junk from your deck if present.

title: Toll Evasion Run
body: Smugglers offer a full-speed run through null tolls while the city tries to erase your gains.

choices.label: Take the evasion kit
choices.description: Increase Protocol Drift by 4%. Gain Toll Evasion Kit. Next combat: start with 1 Nullified.

choices.label: Ride shotgun
choices.description: Gain 45 credits. Next combat: start with 1 Nullified.

choices.label: Flash your bypass
choices.description: Gain 25 credits. Next combat: draw 1 extra card on turn 1.

title: Market Ghost Reunion
body: The market ghost meets its own warranty clerk and both insist the other one died owing you money.

choices.label: Settle the receipt
choices.description: Refresh Market Ghost. Gain 25 credits.

choices.label: Audit the ghosts
choices.description: Gain 60 credits. Remove Ghost Warranty if active.

choices.label: Sign the spectral ledger
choices.description: Increase Protocol Drift by 7%. Gain Auction Seeder. Gain Debt Mark.

title: Black Ice Heart
body: The splinter from the cache points toward a beating shard under the city.

choices.label: Take the heart shard
choices.description: Gain a random rare relic. Take 14 damage. Increase Protocol Drift by 12%.

choices.label: Seal it in a vault
choices.description: Reduce Protocol Drift by 8%. Gain Quarantine Vault.

choices.label: Leave the heart beating
choices.description: Heal 10 HP.

title: Choir Beneath the City
body: Every broken speaker in the undercity sings the same note and waits for you to harmonize.

choices.label: Harmonize cleanly
choices.description: Heal 15 HP. Reduce Protocol Drift by 10%.

choices.label: Let the scrap choir answer
choices.description: Add Junk to your deck. Gain Scrap Choir.

choices.label: Sing the unstable note
choices.description: Increase Protocol Drift by 6%. Gain Symbiont Spindle. Next combat: start with 1 Infect.

title: Debt Court
body: Your debts are tried by a court where the judge is a contract and the jury is interest.

choices.label: Pay judgment
choices.description: Spend 45 credits. Remove Debt Mark if active. Remove Debt Spike if active. Reduce Protocol Drift by 4%.

choices.label: Declare violent bankruptcy
choices.description: Take 12 damage. Remove Debt Mark if active. Remove Debt Spike if active. Gain 20 credits.

choices.label: Accept the court dividend
choices.description: Increase Protocol Drift by 8%. Gain Flesh Dividend. Gain Debt Spike.

title: Grave Census Final
body: The census clerk finds the missing column: your name, written before the fight.

choices.label: Accept official count
choices.description: Refresh Reaper Census. Take 8 damage. Gain 25 credits.

choices.label: Light every lantern
choices.description: Gain Grave Lantern.

choices.label: Erase your line
choices.description: Spend 20 credits. Heal 18 HP. Reduce Protocol Drift by 6%.

title: Infection Bloom Parade
body: A parade of infected lanterns blooms through the district, spreading celebration like a symptom.

choices.label: Crown the parade
choices.description: Refresh Septic Crown. Heal 12 HP. Take 7 damage.

choices.label: Release the relay spores
choices.description: Increase Protocol Drift by 6%. Gain Viral Relay. Next combat: start with 1 Infect.

choices.label: Wear the parasite seal
choices.description: Heal 18 HP.

title: Zero-Day Masquerade
body: Every guest wears the same mask: zero cost, no receipt, no memory.

choices.label: Dance the free sequence
choices.description: Next combat: draw 1 extra card on turn 1.

choices.label: Steal a power mask
choices.description: Increase Protocol Drift by 8%. Add Glitch to your deck. Gain Mummified Wire.

choices.label: Sell the invitation
choices.description: Gain 65 credits.

title: Quarantine Saint
body: A saint of sealed doors offers mercy only after proving you can survive the lock.

choices.label: Accept containment
choices.description: Take 10 damage. Increase Protocol Drift by 5%. Gain Quarantine Vault.

choices.label: Receive absolution
choices.description: Heal 20 HP. Reduce Protocol Drift by 15%.

choices.label: Weaponize the seal
choices.description: Gain Toll Spike. Gain Null Damper. Next combat: start with 1 Suppressed.

title: Spine Breach
body: The Spine Core opens a service hatch and asks whether you want timing, authority, or escape.

choices.label: Claim civic authority
choices.description: Refresh Authority Bypass. Gain 30 credits. Increase Protocol Drift by 6%.

choices.label: Claim perfect timing
choices.description: Increase Protocol Drift by 6%. Gain Spine Script.

choices.label: Escape through the breach
choices.description: Gain 75 credits. Reduce Protocol Drift by 8%.
